name: mirage
text:
Fixed in the code, with the new test passing. It ships once the full test suite finishes, and I will tell you the version.

What is happening: when an order finds nobody selling, that bet is already taken off the list. The next price read then listed it again with the same price, because the rule was only that a newer read exists. The price on offer had not changed.

The change: the app now remembers the exact price that nobody sold at. A newer read that still shows that same price keeps the bet off the list. It returns only when the price changes, meaning real liquidity at a different price, or after 30 minutes. Bets at a new price still go through the usual +EV checks.

On stale odds: the bet had Novig's price at its last read, and the order rejected it because the ask was gone by then. That is a stale ask, not stale fair odds. If these errors stay frequent after the update, tell me, and I will check how old the Novig prices are at the moment you tap Bet.
